Title: REINVENT 4 Mol2MolScaffold
Description: Generates analogues of a query molecule with two REINVENT 4 Mol2Mol priors, trained on ChEMBL pairs that share an identical Murcko scaffold or the generic, unlabelled scaffold. Loeffler and co-workers at AstraZeneca built these transformer priors in an openly licensed design framework. Each prior is sampled at random, the scaffold one first, so repeated runs return different sets; sampling is repeated up to a limit until 100 distinct structures are collected. The query and its stereoisomers are discarded. The scaffold is favoured, not guaranteed.
Interpretation: Up to 100 distinct analogues of the input molecule, sampled from priors trained on pairs that share its exact or generic Murcko scaffold and listed from most to least similar (Morgan Tanimoto); sets differ between runs.
